title: Jithendar.com · CrewAI
description: CrewAI flows, crews, tasks and tool calls of the SEO agent: metrics (Prometheus), run lines (Loki) and traces (Jaeger). Source: jithendar.com repository, grafana/. Both agents: the seo-agent and, since 2026-11-21, the news agent (news crew), job=~"seo-agent|news-agent".

list.name: trace_id
list.label: Trace id
list.description: Click a trace id in the tables, or paste one.

panels.title: Crew cost
panels.description: Estimated spend of crew runs in the last 24 hours (seo_crew_cost_usd_total). All LLM spend, crews or not, is in the budget gauge.

panels.title: Tool errors
panels.description: Share of crew tool calls that failed, timed out or were cancelled.

panels.title: Flow runs by flow and result
Hours since the last successful run
panels.description: Per flow, from seo_flow_runs (seo_flow_last_success_timestamp_seconds). A daily flow over 26 h, or a weekly one over 7.5 days, has stopped succeeding.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, flow, step) (rate(seo_flow_step_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"seo-agent|news-agent", flow=~"$flow"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Task duration p95 by agent
panels.description: One task per agent in each sequential crew; a slow agent here is usually a long model answer or a slow tool.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, crew, agent) (rate(seo_crew_task_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"seo-agent|news-agent", crew=~"$crew"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Tool calls by tool and result
Model calls by purpose and outcome
panels.description: truncated = the answer hit max_tokens; refused; invalid = failed validation; cancelled = the stream was closed.

panels.title: Flow runs (newest first)
panels.description: One flow_finished line per run. Click a trace id to show the run's trace and log lines below.

panels.title: Log lines of this trace (agent and web app)
panels.description: Every line in namespace jithendar with the selected trace id: flow, step, crew, task and tool events from seo-agent, and the web app's lines for the callbacks the run made. Loki keeps only allowlisted fields; the full line is in kubectl logs.

panels.title: Trace ${trace_id}
panels.description: flow.<flow> is the root; under it the steps, crew.<crew>, crew.<crew>.task.<agent>, crew.<crew>.<agent> (each model call), tool.<tool>, llm.call and seo-agent.callback spans from the web app.
